messages:
sam (Sales): Procurement at BioLayer sent OF redline: require DocuSign ID Check for all signers + 99.9% SLA with sliding credits up to 15%. POC is 90 days, est $46,000. Need quick guidance.

rita (Legal): Paste the exact text if you have it. Short take: notarization for small POCs we push back; high SLA/credit caps we counter.

sam (Sales): Quote: "Provider must enable identity verification via DocuSign for all signatories. Provider warrants 99.9% uptime; for each 0.1% below target, Customer may claim service credits up to 15% of monthly fees."

noor (Solutions): We can turn on DocuSign ID Check on the envelope. Dedicated mini-pool spin-up ~3 business days. But committing 99.9% for a short isolated pool is risky.

henry (Engineering): Agreed. Our precedent for short Dedicated POCs is 99.5%. Also we should clarify measurement (rolling 30-day) and exclusions (scheduled maintenance, customer network issues, force majeure). I will draft a short SLA carveout.

rita (Legal): Proposed counter for OF/MSA: "For Proof-of-Concept engagements, Provider offers a 99.5% uptime SLA. Service credits for POCs are limited to the aggregate fees paid for the POC term. Provider accepts electronic signatures executed via DocuSign; DocuSign identity verification satisfies Provider's signer authentication requirement. Provider is not liable for third-party verification failures. Requests for notarization for contracts under $250,000 require escalation and are not a baseline POC requirement." Agree?

jamie (Finance): Finance ok with capping credits to POC fees. If Sales needs leverage we can offer a one-time conversion credit equal to 7.5% of POC fees if Customer signs an annual Dedicated commit within 60 days of POC end. Recommend showing dollar caps in the OF once the final fee is locked.

sam (Sales): Good plan. I'll confirm $46k, enable ID Check only if procurement requires it, and route DocuSign to their procurement + legal then our AE + Rita. Rita, please upload the redline counter to the procurement ticket today.

docsign-bot: Template "Redwood POC OF" created (tpl_7710). Tip: enable ID Check auth when customer requests identity verification.

rita (Legal): I'll upload the counter with the 99.5% POC SLA, credit cap equal to POC fees, conversion credit language, and Henry's SLA carveouts by EOD. If procurement insists on notarization for this <$250k POC, escalate to Legal leadership.

sam (Sales): Thanks team :thumbsup:
